title: Signal: Yarn lockfile resolves an archive over cleartext
scope: A yarn.lock file that declares a lockfile `resolved` URL that uses cleartext http.
limitations: It matches a lockfile `resolved` URL that uses cleartext http in the parsed yarn.lock; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A yarn.lock that mentions a lockfile `resolved` URL that uses cleartext http in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
